# sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

## Breaking change: user name fields

CAUTION: Update your integrations before you upgrade. The `name` field of `/v2/users` is removed, and requests that use it fail.

The `name` field is now two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. Update your code to read and write the two new fields.

## New: incremental transfers

sqlpipe now has an `--incremental` flag. If you set this flag, sqlpipe copies only the rows that changed after the last transfer. A full copy is not necessary.

## Faster Parquet writes

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1.x. The write path uses less memory and fewer buffer copies. No change to your configuration is necessary.
